newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banerj sale may be delayed until Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banerj sale may be delayed until Thursday.

text.p: The privatization auction of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj, scheduled for today, may be delayed until Thursday, a spokesman for the Rio state Finance office said.

The spokesman said the sale might be delayed because of bureaucratic details regarding a key loan approved by the Senate late Tuesday that must be settled before the auction, set for 1600 local time/1900 GMT, takes place.
He said Finance Secretary Marco Aurelio Alencar is on his way to Brasilia to work out those details.

The 3.09 billion reais loan to Rio de Janeiro state will be made by federal mortgage bank Caixa Economica Federal (CEF) and will be used to cover Banerj's pension and payroll-related debt, which currently makes the bank unsellable.
Banerj, the first Brazilian state-owned bank to be privatized, had been scheduled to be auctioned last week, but the auction was put on hold pending the Senate approval.

Four banks have presented financial guarantees to bid at the auction. They are Bradesco, BCN, Banco Itau and Cia. de Investimentos Latino-Americana, owned by an unidentified foreign bank and represented by local Banco Pactual.
